system.description:
Dwarven Society is a literate one. Dwarven children are taught to decipher and inscribe runes from a very young age. This skill counts as both Read and Write for Dwarves.

Obstacles: As for Read and Write.

FoRKs: History skills, Chronology of Kings

Skill Type: Academic. Tools: Yes, writing only. Expendable.

Restrictions: Dwarves only in character burning

Root: Per

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 269
